notes.title: Season 2024 Update is live!
notes.content:
Greetings, festive friends!

The time of the year has come again! It is Christmas time. 
Introducing the Season 2024 update today. The journey continues with many improvements and new levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944372/0048c5f5c01f456f88daabd30025fc33eb1bb2af.png[/img]

[h1]Challenge Mode[/h1]
Announced last year, the Challenge Mode is finally here! It launches with 3 exciting levels designed to push your skills to the limit, offering a tougher twist compared to the story levels. Don’t worry—more are on the way in future updates!

[h1]Training Mode[/h1]
The original challenge levels make a return as Training Levels, perfect for newcomers to learn game mechanics and warm up. While the training menu is still the old version, updates will soon make it more polished and controller-ready for an even better experience.

[h1]Tweaked Jumping[/h1]
Jumping has been slightly refined to address frustration, especially in the early stages of the game. While the core mechanics remain unchanged, these adjustments aim to make tricky sections more approachable without altering the overall gameplay feel. For experienced players, it will still feel the same!

[h1]A Round of Optimizations[/h1]
Last year’s update introduced some bugs—we’ve worked hard to address these and refine the experience. If you still encounter issues, please share them in the Steam Forums. We’re here to help!

A huge thank you to everyone who reported bugs in the Steam Forums—we truly appreciate your help! And an honest apology for the delay in addressing some of these issues—it’s taken until this season, but we’re committed to making things right. If any issues persist, please let us know!

[h1]A Note about last years Jumping[/h1]
Last year, some players mentioned that jumping felt different. Rest assured, no changes were made to the jump mechanics at that time. However, many switched from keyboard to controller thanks to the new support, and the controls can feel a bit different between the two setups. We recommend experimenting to find what feels best for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944372/fd3c6b548c50aa8466b91b1f49846ed5a3a3c94e.png[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Our elves are hard at work, fine-tuning and improving the game further. Fixes for any new issues and exciting additions like new challenge levels are on the horizon. Let’s see what the rest of the year brings! Share your feedback and suggestions in the Steam Forum!

[b]As we wrap up this update, if you haven't already, consider supporting the game by leaving a review on the Steam shop page. Your input is invaluable in making the game even better.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/920770/Santas_Story_of_Christmas/

Happy holidays, and see you on the slopes!
- max

notes.title: Available now on macOS!
notes.content:
Greetings, festive friends!

I'm thrilled to announce that Santa's Story of Christmas is now available on macOS! This marks a major milestone, reaching a new platform and inviting even more players into the enchanting world of Santa's Story. Experience festive adventures, spread joy with Santa and his elves, and immerse yourself in the holiday spirit. The macOS version offers the same captivating gameplay and unique magic of Santa's Story of Christmas, now conveniently accessible on your Mac.

[h1]The end of Season 2023![/h1]
With this announcement we end the Season 2023.
As we wrap up this season, a heartfelt thank you for your fantastic support! We hope you enjoyed the latest update. We're taking a bit more time to fine-tune the new Challenge Mode and prepare for an exciting next season!

[b]Have any wishes or suggestions for the upcoming update?[/b] Feel free to share them in the Steam forums. Stay tuned for thrilling developments!

[b]If you come across any bugs or errors in the latest update[/b], please let us know in the Steam forums. Your feedback is invaluable!

[h1]Support us[/h1]
As the holiday spirit fills the air, we're delighted to welcome new players to Santa's Story of Christmas! If you've been enchanted by the festive magic, kindly share your thoughts with a cheerful review on Steam. Your feedback is a special gift to us!

[h1]Sale[/h1]
Our game is now available at a special holiday price. If you're still in need of a last-minute gift, now's the perfect time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/920770/Santas_Story_of_Christmas/

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Christmas is just around the corner! So we wish everyone all the best and Merry Christmas. Have fun and success to all who are still in the middle of saving Christmas!

See you next year for the upcoming season! Expect more exciting content, including the new Challenge Mode, and additional improvements! It's gonna be a blast – don't miss out!

Have a nice Christmas time and stay safe!
- max

notes.title: Season 2023 Update is live!
notes.content:
Greetings, festive friends!

The time of the year has come again! It is Christmas time. 
Introducing the first Season 2023 update today. After a year without any updates, the journey continues, and there's been significant progress behind the scenes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944372/ba19d992a9200ccde990a9c67187f0bfef1810fb.png[/img]

[h1]Unleashing Unreal Power[/h1]
The game has received a significant boost with the latest Unreal Engine 5 update, bringing behind-the-scenes improvements and a smoother overall performance. This isn't just a visual enhancement; it's a crucial step that will greatly assist in the ongoing development and improvement of the game.

[h1]Level Refinement[/h1]
In response to community wishes and to elevate the overall experience, Level 7 and 8 are divided into two charming segments each. The journey is now more delightful and enjoyable, ensuring every player has a holly jolly time! This means there are now a total of 11 Story Levels, each accompanied by its own set of achievements.

[h1]New Penguin[/h1]
Meet the updated penguin! The original was a charming, but our latest addition is a winter wonder! Dive into the chilly fun with this adorable new character.

[h1]UI Improvements and Controller Support[/h1]
The Level Menu has received a facelift for a more user-friendly experience. Loading levels is now smoother, and there is now a full controller support (BETA), making the game compatible with the Steam Deck. It's time to play with comfort and style.

[h1]A Round of Optimizations[/h1]
But wait, there's more! We've fine-tuned, optimized, and sprinkled a little extra magic across the game. If you spot any pesky bugs or quirks, be our festive hero and let us know in the Steam Forum!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944372/fd3c6b548c50aa8466b91b1f49846ed5a3a3c94e.png[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Our elves are working tirelessly on the Challenge Mode, set to make its debut in the next update!  
There's a sack full of other improvements in the pipeline, and with a bit of luck, there may be another substantial update this season. Share your feedback and suggestions in the Steam Forum!

[b]As we wrap up this update, if you haven't already, consider supporting the game by leaving a review on the Steam shop page. Your input is invaluable in making the game even better.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/920770/Santas_Story_of_Christmas/

Have a nice Christmas time and stay save!
- max

notes.title: Season 2019 Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944372/b57f95ff68eaf13d3cc4589d515f5fcbf6e3943a.png[/img]

Hello people,

The time of the year has come again! It is Christmas time. 
To celebrate this, there is the big Season 2019 update today. It contains new content, improvements and bug fixes. All changes are noted below.  
And to get in the right spirit, there is a trailer for the new season! 

[previewyoutube=rTA26QOxlXE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[b]Starter Mode[/b]
In order to better get into the game, there is now a starter mode. In contrast to the classic mode, the checkpoints work differently and you have unlimited life. So if you're not so trained in the game, you'll lose less of your level progress if you make mistakes. Also the levels are a bit easier on starter mode. For some players the game was too frustrating. That shouldn't be a problem anymore!
[b]
Steam Achievements[/b]
There are Steam Achievements in the game now. So you can keep a good eye on your progress and compete with your friends. Some are really a challenge, so try it out ;)
New ones will be added in the near future.
 
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[b]Level Enhancements & Visual Improvements[/b]
Based on feedback all levels have been revised to improve the overall playing experience. In addition, the design of e.g. caves has been reworked to make them look better. There are also a few general visual improvements in the UI and a few other things, like better looking snow particles.

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
Engine update and some optimizations provide a better performance. Also there will be more improvements in the near future!


[h1]Update Changelog[/h1]
[list][*]Tweaked level 1 - 9
[*]Reworked snow
[*]Changed some cutscenes
[*]Updated engine on 4.23
[*]Changed main menu UI
[*]Changed level menu UI
[*]Changed tutorial UI
[*]Performance optimizations
[*]Added new mouse cursor

notes.title: Update "Snowflake" 2 is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33944372/6f4884e298cffd4b87cd014c3298ff35d9c4c2c9.png[/img]

Hello Christmas Lovers,

Since the release there is even more feedback. Based on this, this update is focusing on two things besides a few bug fixes. 

[u][h1]Controls [/h1][/u]
The first is a redesign of the controls. At the moment the response when jumping is imprecise. This is now changed. No matter how fast you press double space there is always a second jump. However, this jump is not always the longest but it depends on a certain timing. To jump the furthest you have to do the second jump when Santa is at the highest point of the first jump. This mechanic is explained in the tutorial.
If you've gotten used to jumping before, nothing's gonna change for you. Only for beginners it is now easier to get along with the controls.  

[u][h1]Extended Tutorial[/h1][/u]
The second improvement is an extension of the tutorial. In addition to the jump mechanics already mentioned, more elementary things are now explained in the game. So, for example, there is now a hint to the camera handling settings. With this setting it is possible to set a direct camera handling in the options which doesn't react as delayed as the default smooth camera handling. 
[u]With this update it is definitely recommended to play the tutorial again.[/u] You can now enter it in the start game menu.

With these changes it will be much easier to handle the game. If you have any questions, suggestions or criticism about the changes, please feel free to post your feedback in the forum.   

[h1]Fixed bugs & improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed scoreboard in tutorial
[*] Fixed checkpoint positining in level 7
[*] Added special checkpoint in level 1 on "easy"
[*] Added special checkpoint in level 3 on "easy"
[*] Added tutorial for level information 
[*] Added killzones in level 2 for fall damage
[*] Replaced golden present in level 2
[*] Tweaked a few obstacles in level 1
[*] Tweaked a few obstacles in level 2
[*] Added arrows in level 1 for better path finding 
[*] Reworked jump mechanic 
[*] Added text if you die too often
[*] Added button for tutorial in start game menu
[*] Tweaked a few obstacles in level 9
[*] Fixed save in options menu
[*] Fixed text on respawn
[/list]

Hello Christmas Lovers,

This is the first update since release. As this is a Christmas game, the updates will have names related to Christmas. Not every update will have a new name, because such a name stands for a certain period or a certain feature. For example, the next updates will be called "Snowflake" as we are shortly after the release. The "Snowflake" updates deal with bugs and feedback from the community.
